Cross a word

02

Keep it economical

Each word costs 10 points, plus 1 per letter. Fewer points means a better connection.

03

Close the gap

Your final bridge may cross two words, one from each group, to complete the puzzle.

About the word list & placement rules

This edition uses a curated word list. Words must be 2–15 letters, cannot be repeated, and cannot overlap in the same direction. Neighboring words need a blank square between them unless they cross. Hints are free and show a legal next move when available.
